title: Parallel spans are not additive latency
method: Synthetic sequence: 30 ms local work then simultaneous required branches of 120 and 80 ms; elapsed=30+max(120,80)=150. Sum 230 would double-count overlap. Excludes extra overhead and clock error.
alt: Parallel spans are not additive latency: Local work 30 ms, Branch A 120 ms, Branch B 80 ms, End-to-end 150 ms. Synthetic example.
